title: Target criticality is higher than every parent passes on
cardHint: The target criticality is higher than every parent passes on. Often a parent relationship is missing: SACM checks the mapping first.
cardText: A target value higher than every value the parents pass on is unusual: often a parent relationship is missing. SACM checks the mapping first, so these CIs start under Check the mapping first. Parents over a relationship excluded from calculation do not count. When the mapping of a CI is complete, press "Mapping is complete: ask the owner" on its line: the CI moves to Asked of the owner, and the owner is asked to confirm the value or lower it with the criticality request.

message.subject: Criticality above the parent CIs
message.intro: A target value is higher than every value the parent CIs pass on. We checked the mapping: no parent relationship is missing.
message.ask: Could you confirm that the value is right? If it is too high, please lower it with the request {request:criticality}.
message.why: Criticality flows down from the parents. A CI rated higher than all of its parents is unusual.
